Richarlison Excluded from Tottenham Squad Amid Transfer Speculation

Richarlison has been excluded from Tottenham Hotspur's Premier League squad, with reports indicating this decision is linked to transfer interest from Turkey. The Brazilian forward's absence from the squad was noted amid speculation about a potential move. The exact reasons for his exclusion and the status of any transfer negotiations remain unclear in the provided coverage.
